evidence.note: Directory paginates via ?wpv_paged=N query params (WordPress Views/WPV plugin), 6 pages of ~10 venues each

researcher_reported_families.notes: Walked all 6 paginated pages and fetched each of the 54 individual member profile pages for stated capacity figures. Contrary to Package 05's note that this directory needed a browser for JS pagination, WebFetch alone successfully traversed every page via the wpv_paged URL query parameter (server-side WordPress Views pagination, not a client-only JS barrier) -- a playwright browser session was opened but proved unnecessary once this was discovered. Of 54 members, 4 stated a specific, identifiable room/hall with capacity >=1000 not already held by Package 05 (Ivor Crewe Lecture Hall/Event Essex, Kent Sports Centre, Maxwell Hall/Salford, Central Hall/York) -- emitted to new-venues.jsonl with capacity corroborated against each university's own official conferencing site. Several other members stated vague, non-room-specific aggregate figures (e.g. 'accommodating over 2,000 delegates throughout the year' for Portsmouth, 'capacities ranging from 4-2000 guests' for Leeds, 'up to 1000 delegates' for Nottingham Venues) that could not be tied to one specific room and were not treated as capacity evidence for a single venue -- these are honest non-findings, not omissions. Three members' largest room was already held by Package 05 under a different label (Great Hall, University of Birmingham; McEwan Hall, Edinburgh; Sport Central, Northumbria) and were not re-emitted.

researcher_reported_families.notes: Package 05 had spot-checked ~18 of 53 known member URLs from this sitemap. Fetched and recorded a stated capacity for all 53, completing the remaining ~35 unchecked. Two candidates initially appeared to reach >=1000 on the VoE profile page itself (Unique Venues Birmingham / Library of Birmingham 'Level 2 Library Feature Space' at 1,000 reception; Hellidon Lakes Hotel 'Top Field' at 1000 theatre) but neither survived cross-checking against independent sources: official/third-party sources for Library of Birmingham cap out at 550 banqueting and The Rep's House auditorium at ~800-825, and independent listings for Hellidon Lakes cap its largest bookable room at 300 delegates with no corroboration anywhere of a 1000-capacity 'Top Field'. Per the brief's rule that a single uncorroborated figure is not sufficient capacity evidence, neither was promoted to new-venues.jsonl -- recorded here as a genuine non-finding, not an omission. One member (University of Birmingham Conferences & Events / Great Hall) independently corroborated Package 05's existing 1,000-theatre-style figure for the already-held 'Great Hall, University of Birmingham'. No other VoE member's stated capacity reached 1,000 in any configuration; this consortium's roster is materially smaller-scale (boardrooms, training centres, hotel suites, country-house hotels) than Academic Venue Solutions or the major national conference/exhibition operators.
